subject: Autobound: what a newsletter issue gives your models
body:
The fit at Autobound is on the input side. Your platform page counts 35+ public sources, and your models already parse unstructured documents including podcast transcripts. A newsletter issue is the same shape of input with better provenance: published on a schedule, dated, and carrying named companies, people and sponsors in the body text.

We hand that back as records, publication, article, entities, topics, sponsor, each with URL and date.

If it is worth testing, I can send 5,000 records mapped to your signal taxonomy, and your team can measure whether newsletter mentions move accounts you already score.
